# One-Sentence Summary

powsimR models count-distribution characteristics from reference bulk or
single-cell RNA-seq data, simulates differential-expression designs, and
reports power and error-rate behavior across sample-size choices.

# Scope for simitall

Use as an optional design sensitivity layer after the simulation architecture
has declared biological replicates, effect sizes, cell types or conditions, and
analysis endpoints.

# Agent-Safe Takeaways

- Power is conditional on the fitted or assumed mean-dispersion/dropout model,
  effect-size distribution, and tested pipeline.
- Produce power and false-discovery curves across sample-size scenarios instead
  of one unqualified sample-size recommendation.
- Keep reference-fitting samples biologically coherent before fitting a count model.

# Limitations and Guardrails

Reference-derived parameters transfer imperfectly across protocols, tissues,
cell types, and organisms. Clearly label reference-based versus fully synthetic
power estimates.
